effects.prompt: Search your deck for a cog to put into the arena?

_comment:
'When this hits, you may search your deck for a cog, put it into the arena, then shuffle.' Mechanologist Action - Attack (OmensOfTheThirdAge). No printed keywords.

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT, UNGATED - release note 1 ('triggers when it hits (e.g. heroes or allies)') names ally hits explicitly, so there is deliberately no ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate. ON_HIT is mapped at trigger_types.py:6.

OPTIONALITY: MAY (effect_types.py:3788+, read this session) supplies release note 1's 'you choose whether or not to search' - declining runs nothing in the block.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST (it named LOOK_AT + SELECT_FROM_REF + MOVE_REF): SEARCH_DECK (effect_types.py:1668-1833, read this session) implements the whole clause and matches all four release notes where the LOOK_AT chain does not:
- Fail-to-find is built in (ask_optional with FAIL_TO_FIND, :1791-1807) - release note 4 ('you can fail to find a cog even if you still have one in your deck').
- effect_shuffle runs UNCONDITIONALLY before placement (:1815), found or not - release note 4 ('you will still shuffle your deck afterwards').
- The chosen card goes through put_object -> Zone.add, so entry rules and identity-replacement effects see it (release note 3, 'Copper Cogs entering with 2 steam counters'); no priority between the steps is plain sequential resolution of one effects list (release note 2).
- subtype filter reads 'subtype' and tests case-insensitively against the candidate's subtypes (:1770-1773).

DESTINATION 'permanents', not 'arena': Player.zone_by_name (state.py:1023-1033, read this session) has no 'arena' key - 'permanents' IS the arena zone and holds items; put_object resolves it via get_zone. Same spelling the shipped arc/pour_the_mold_blue.json precedent uses for items entering the arena. SEARCH_GRAVEYARD's own handler maps its 'arena' input to 'permanents' for the same reason (:1884-1885).

DATA GAP, DISCLOSED: this card_data snapshot contains NO cards with a Cog subtype (scanned slug_index by_slug: zero hits for 'cog' in any subtypes list; Copper/Golden/Titanium Cogs are absent from the DB entirely). So as the data stands the search always fails-to-find and shuffles - it fails closed, never wrongly. Authored per the printed text with subtype 'Cog'; the filter starts matching automatically if cog cards enter the DB carrying that subtype. No JSON change needed then.

amount 1 = 'a cog'. No other clauses in the printed text.
